policy.use_mathlib: An inspected interface, or direct composition of existing operations, expresses the archived interface with matching meaning, domains and assumptions.
policy.small_adaptation: Existing mathematics supports the interface; a thin wrapper, representation conversion, bounded convention clarification or local connecting proof remains.
policy.new_infrastructure: A substantive construction, essential theory, or core algorithm required by the interface remains to be developed or supplied.
policy.scope: Assess the archived interface and its variants, not the difficulty of proving every related paper theorem. Do not add unrequested structure laws to a scalar definition.
policy.boundary: Classify by missing mathematical content, not code length, a missing same-name API, or legacy availability categories.
policy.method: Reassessment of the completed declaration, variant and gap evidence, using explicit sufficiency/expression criteria and reviewed construction exceptions. These are planning estimates, not compiled Lean implementations or fresh searches.
policy.limits: Retain source caveats and domain obligations. Yellow is not an absence claim; red must identify a substantive missing construction. Unsearched or indeterminate work stays pending in working data.
